name: chowsmart
description: ChowSmart — restaurant discovery, recipes, breads & intelligent menu planning by PCTL

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
